hebrewText: וַ/יִּתְפֹּ֛שׂ אֶת אֲגַ֥ג מֶֽלֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֖ק חָ֑י וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֥ים לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב

tokens.bdb: to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably
tokens.kjv: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings

tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country
alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
tokens.explanation: chai — vivo, vivente, ser que tem vida

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose
tokens.kjv: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive

tokens.explanationEn: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive

tokens.bdb: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
tokens.kjv: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.
tokens.explanation: peh — boca, linguagem, beira, entrada, abertura

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.
